result.instructions: Tools for Ploomes, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are open in the sales pipeline, and what is the total value?"; "Create a deal for contact 4521 called 'Annual renewal' in the first stage."; "Show the tasks due this week that are not finished yet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ploomes data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ploomes_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ploomes_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ploomes_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ploomes_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ploomes_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a customer (contact) in the Ploomes account. Only the fields you set are sent. Ploomes API: POST /Contacts.

register.description: Registration number (CPF or CNPJ) if known.

type_id.description: Contact type id (see the account's contact types).

origin_id.description: Origin id (where the contact came from).

company_id.description: Id of the company (parent contact), if any.

field_key.description: Custom field key (the Key of a field from ploomes_list_fields).

tools.name: ploomes_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create a deal (sales opportunity) for a contact in a sales stage. Ploomes API: POST /Deals.

contact_id.description: Id of the contact (customer) the deal belongs to.

field_key.description: Custom field key (the Key of a field from ploomes_list_fields).

tools.name: ploomes_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Change fields of one deal (title, value, stage, contact, custom fields). Only the fields you set are sent. Ploomes API: PATCH /Deals({Id}).

field_key.description: Custom field key (the Key of a field from ploomes_list_fields).

tools.name: ploomes_win_deal
tools.title: Win a deal
tools.description: Mark one deal as won. The deal must allow winning under its pipeline rules. Ploomes API: POST /Deals({Id})/Win.

tools.name: ploomes_lose_deal
tools.title: Lose a deal
tools.description: Mark one deal as lost with a loss reason (ids from ploomes_list_loss_reasons). Ploomes API: POST /Deals({Id})/Lose.

tools.name: ploomes_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task (to-do with a due date) linked to a contact. Ploomes API: POST /Tasks.

field_key.description: Custom field key (the Key of a field from ploomes_list_fields).

tools.name: ploomes_finish_task
tools.title: Finish a task
tools.description: Mark one task as finished. Ploomes API: POST /Tasks({Id})/Finish.

tools.name: ploomes_create_interaction
tools.title: Log an interaction
tools.description: Log an interaction record (call, email, meeting or note) on a contact or a deal. Ploomes API: POST /InteractionRecords.

contact_id.description: Id of the contact the interaction belongs to.

deal_id.description: Id of the deal the interaction belongs to.

date.description: Date and time with offset, e.g. '2026-11-26T10:00:00-03:00'.

field_key.description: Custom field key (the Key of a field from ploomes_list_fields).
